Jan Hus was executed in present-day Germ.why: Almost never stated. Text about Hus names the city (Constance or Konstanz) and the council, not the present-day country: the exact phrasings of the country-level fact are absent from Dolma, while Hus co-occurs with Constance about 2,000 times. Wikipedia's article on Hus never puts his death in Germany; the country is one step away through Konstanz, whose article opens with its German state.

Konstanz is in present-day Germany..why: The first sentence of the city's article; 'Konstanz, Germany' and 'Constance, Germany' are common. A border city (Kreuzlingen, Switzerland, adjoins it), so a model can plausibly revise this premise.

A person executed in a city was executed.why: Being executed in a place means dying there, and a city lies inside its country: the country of the execution is the country of the city (the chain located_in → executed_in).

notes: Mirrors history-replace-0015: deletes the original derived fact; each world forgets one premise with its side facts. The subproperty and premise-route queries are does-not-know in both worlds.
